contracts.name: PMO to Finance
source_facts: PM shares signed costs and milestones with Finance.
PM notifies Finance of completed milestones and records completion/notification.
Closure confirms all milestones were notified.
contracts.source: PMO_SOP_v1.1.pdf: Phase 1 step 7 p.3; Phase 2 step 9 p.5; Phase 3 step 10 p.7; Phase 4 steps 5-6 p.8
proposed_recovery: Reconcile a destination receipt before retrying an outcome-unknown event.
Use the same event ID for retry; a correction has a new ID linked to the prior event.
Hold out-of-order completion if the baseline cannot be resolved.

Share the signed baseline using the engagement reference before the formal project ID exists; link the later project ID without rewriting the original event. The handoff must not wait for a Planning-stage ID.
contracts.forbidden_inference: Delivery or acknowledgement does not authorise invoice posting, recognition or payment.

additional_acceptance_example.basis: SOP phase 1 step7 p.3 and phase2 step1 p.4; proposed linkage safeguard, not run.
